analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on August 14, 2026, reporting strong financial performance driven by healthy volume expansion and new operational capabilities. Management highlighted the commencement of the Marol manufacturing facility and the upcoming Jaipur plant to support growing customer requirements and expansion into new domestic and international markets. The company maintained its full-year guidance of 50% to 60% value growth and 30% to 40% volume growth, while projecting sustainable EBITDA margins of 7.5% to 8% going forward. Additionally, the company announced a rights issue of up to INR100 crores to fuel its ongoing growth strategy and capital requirements. Shanti Gold International Limited presented its Q1 FY27 performance, reporting revenue from operations of ₹716.4 Cr and net profit of ₹50.5 Cr.

guidance.claim: The company expects top-line value growth of 50% to 60% and volume growth of 30% to 40% for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year. So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

guidance.claim: The sustainable EBITDA margin is projected to be around 7.5% to 8% for the year.
guidance.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

guidance.claim: Management expects around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60% to 70% growth in terms of value for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

guidance.claim: Management stated that the core PAT business margin will be around 4% plus.
guidance.quote: This margin would be around 4% and all, which we've been maintaining that 4% plus and all.

guidance.claim: Management expects export share to increase from 10% to 20% or maybe more.
guidance.quote: So I told you like this year will be like from 5% to we are going to go up to 10% or maybe more. Sorry, from 10% to 20%.

guidance.claim: Management expects next year's turnover to be around INR 3,000 crores to INR 3,500 crores with 35% to 40% growth.
guidance.quote: So next year like around we expecting a turnover of around INR 3,000 crores to INR 3,500 crores and with 35% to 40% growth.

demand_outlook.claim: India's organized jewellery market outlook is constructive, supported by wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and preference for branded jewellery.
demand_outlook.quote: From an industry perspective, the outlook for the organized jewellery continues to remain constructive. India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains very bullish on gold in the long term as fundamentals remain very strong.
demand_outlook.quote: So the long-term, our vision towards the gold is very, very bullish. The long-term fundamentals remain very strong. So we are hopeful that the gold will, maybe there could be a short-term jitters in the near-term, but going forward in the long-term, we expect a good rally in the gold market, and we remain very bullish on that because the fundamentals remain very strong for the gold.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees huge potential in its international business once the Dubai office compliance and approvals are in place.
demand_outlook.quote: Huge potential. As of now, because Dubai is the gateway for us to have that international footprint and all. So once this war and all gets over, things get stabilized and all, so we see a huge potential coming around because we are just catering to three, four countries now.

demand_outlook.claim: Key demand for gold jewellery in India is seasonally driven by weddings and festivals.
demand_outlook.quote: Seasonal demand from weddings, Diwali & harvest festivals

demand_outlook.claim: Growing disposable income among the rising middle class drives demand for gold as a status symbol and investment.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing disposable income drives gold as status symbol & investment

demand_outlook.claim: Despite elevated gold prices, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments. We continue to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Retailers are increasingly outsourcing to trusted and scalable manufacturers who can offer quality, consistency, and execution at scale.
demand_outlook.quote: One of the most encouraging trends we are witnessing today is the increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers, retailers, as retailers continue to focus on expanding their footprint, inventory optimizing, and faster design cycles. We are increasingly partnering with trusted and scalable manufacturers who can offer quality, consistency, and execution at scale.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations have successfully commenced at the new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex allotted for the Jaipur facility is around INR47 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol facility in Mumbai will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur continues to progress in line with expectations.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol factory is almost ready and expected to start in a month or so, while the Jaipur factory should start around September or October.
capex_expansion.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 stood at INR716.38 crores with an EBITDA margin of 9.97%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR71.45 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 9.97%.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 2% to 2.5% of the quarter's EBITDA margin comprised unrealized inventory gains carried over from last year due to a change in the inventory valuation method.
margins_costs.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: Shanti Gold reported a gross margin of 10.9% for Q1 FY27.
The company recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.0% in Q1 FY27.
The PAT margin stood at 7.1% for Q1 FY27.
Higher production improves fixed-cost absorption and overall manufacturing efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: Higher production improves fixed-cost absorption and manufacturing efficiency

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margins stood at 10.17% compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 10.17% as compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 EBITDA margins stood at 9.86% compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% as compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: The company transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from FIFO to the weighted average cost method with retrospective effect from April 01, 2024.
margins_costs.quote: The company has transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from the First In, First Out, FIFO method to the weighted average cost WAC method with retrospective effect from April 01, 2024.

orders_capacity.claim: The capacity utilization of the existing Mumbai facility is currently at 75%.
Installed capacity post commissioning of the Marol facility stands at ~6,700 kg per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity: ~6,700 kg pa (Andheri + Marol, post commissioning)

orders_capacity.claim: The existing Andheri manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity additions will take total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

orders_capacity.claim: The present capacity utilization is around 65%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares aggregating up to INR100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a net debt-to-equity ratio around 0.50 and intends to keep it below 1x.
capital_allocation.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

capital_allocation.claim: Management highlighted consistently improving returns alongside a steadily deleveraging balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: Consistently improving returns and a steadily deleveraging balance sheet signal strong fundamental momentum

risks_headwinds.claim: Product, regional, and export market expansion helps lower concentration risk for the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: Expansion across regions, products, and export markets reduces concentration risk

risks_headwinds.claim: The incorporation timeline for the Dubai subsidiary has been extended to June '26 due to geopolitical issues and wars.
risks_headwinds.quote: So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good.
